name: Poison Blade Dance
detail: MDarkElf_anim has no SpAtk09 sequence. Every dumped ukx was scanned; spatk09 exists only as SpAtk09_Hand on Orc.ukx (FOrc/MOrc/Skirt_FOrc). LineageWarrior.int [MFighter] does not set this slot for dual (weapon index 3), and substituting the body suffix on the slots it does set does not name a sequence in DarkElf.ukx.
